summary: A gap-up open is on the cards after the long weekend, with Gift Nifty up over 100 pts as Asian markets rally on easing US rate-hike fears.

detail.leaders: Asian markets higher; US tech led Friday's rally
detail.tone: The setup has flipped from Thursday's rout: global risk appetite improved over the break as weak US jobs data cooled Fed hike bets.
watch: Whether the gap-up holds through the session
RBI MPC tone as the meeting begins
FII flows after Thursday's ₹9,484 cr outflow

top.title: Weak US jobs data lifts Wall Street
top.line: US payrolls rose just 29,000 in September; jobless rate climbed to 4.2%, cooling hike bets
more: Dow +0.5% to 51,176.46; the Nasdaq hit an intraday record
US bond yields eased, supporting Asian markets on Monday

top.title: RBI MPC begins; most see a 25 bp hike
top.line: Eight of 10 economists in a BS poll expect the repo rate to rise to 5.50% on Oct 7
more: A hike would be the first since February 2023
Some economists expect another hike in December

more: Shares list on both BSE and NSE
